facts.business: Zee Media Corporation Limited operates as an integrated multi-platform news and media enterprise in India, delivering trusted journalism across television, digital, and social media platforms in multiple languages.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to significant accumulated losses and negative working capital as at 31 March 2026; however, financial statements prepared on going concern basis considering Board-approved business plan, capital infusion, monetization through new revenue streams, and cost rationalisation measures.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to significant accumulated losses and negative working capital
Dependence on advertising revenue in a dynamic media environment
Regulatory and compliance risks in the media sector
Technology disruption and shifting audience consumption patterns
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with wholly owned subsidiaries (Zee Akaash News Private Limited, Indiadotcom Digital Private Limited, Zee Media Inc, Pinewz Digital Private Limited), associates (Today Merchandise Private Limited, Today Retail Network Private Limited), key management personnel, and other related parties including Creantum Security Solutions Private Limited, Digital Subscriber Management and Consultancy Services Private Limited, Diligent Media Corporation Limited, Subhash Chandra Foundation, Essel Corporate LLP, Ez-Mall Online Limited, Pan India Network Limited, Altilis Technologies Private Limited. Certain parties reclassified as non-related parties w.e.f. 01 April 2025 post review.
